lines.say: You just joined a new team, and the codebase is 200,000 lines of code.
Understand Anything turns any codebase, knowledge base or docs into an interactive knowledge graph.
Every file, function and class becomes a node you can click, search and explore.
The understand command orchestrates 5 specialized agents in a multi-agent pipeline.
Tree-sitter and LLMs split the work, so each one does what it does best.
A domain view maps your code to real business processes, with domains, flows and steps.
You can even ask questions, like how the payment flow works.
It explains 12 programming patterns, like generics and closures, in context wherever they appear.
The repo has 85754 stars, and it is MIT licensed.
In Claude Code, add the plugin from the marketplace, install it, and run the understand command.
The graph is just JSON, so commit it once and your teammates skip the pipeline.
Send this to someone who just joined a new team.
That was Understand Anything, by Egonex-AI.
